QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/`, then the system `ldconfig` cache
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the order of env overrides, then the user directory, then the system cache, but it says "nested and flat layouts" only for `$ENTROPIC_HOME`. The item requires two layouts tried per root, so the answer gestures at part of it and the item resolves to MISS.
